source_contract: verified hash-chained JSONL fault ledgers plus versioned human fault books and private atomic central registry
identity_rule: stable faultbook_id and deterministic import_id; exact source duplicates suppress content writes while independently verified binding metadata may advance
lifecycle_rule: source registration and one successful invocation never prove host binding, provider interception, remediation or closure
closure_rule: CLOSED is rejected while regression tests remain open; universal synchronization is prohibited unless every registered consumer is VERIFIED_HOST_BOUND
history_rule: event history is append-only; changed sources preserve revision identity; equal-length divergent compatibility records require explicit merge
privacy_rule: raw events, local paths, storage references and consumer proof references are excluded from the public manifest
